scope: Official Skyrim, Dawnguard, Hearthfire, and Dragonborn destinations needed by the Product-approved completion domains; no Creation Club or radiant-only destination expansion.

region_reviews.proposal: Use Raven Rock / South as the ordinary service region and Skaal / North as an expedition region.
region_reviews.reason: The two-region model reduces long Survival journeys without creating a region for every island landmark; Product approval is required before task population.

scope_reviews.proposed_disposition: Exclude from Unique Spells & Powers pending Product review.
scope_reviews.reason: It is a fixed quest reward and discrete power, but it has only three lifetime uses rather than being a permanent reusable ability. The potential Locations are intentionally not canonicalized until inclusion is approved.

scope_reviews.reward: Equipment-bound powers such as Breath of Nchuak and Ahzidal's Genius
scope_reviews.proposed_disposition: Exclude as separate Unique Spells & Powers completion rewards.
scope_reviews.reason: These effects exist only while the associated collectible equipment is worn; their Locations are already present for Dragonborn content.

scope_reviews.reward: Detect Life and other ordinarily purchasable spells with fixed copies or quest rewards
scope_reviews.proposed_disposition: Exclude from the focused Unique Spells & Powers domain.
scope_reviews.reason: The Product boundary excludes ordinary purchasable spell tomes. Treva's Watch was removed from the catalog after this scope audit because it otherwise had no approved completion purpose.

volunruud.reason: The ruin is between Whiterun's northern road network and the southern Pale; either city can be a practical staging hub.

korvanjund.reason: The ruin lies near the Whiterun/Pale transition; the Whiterun road is direct, while Dawnstar matches northern geography.

arcwind_point.reason: The mountain site is approached from the Ivarstead side but lies near southern mountain routes; it is not part of the High Hrothgar climb itself.

valthume.reason: The ruin is in the eastern Reach, but its road approach can be more practical from Whiterun than from Markarth.

high_gate_ruins.reason: The ruin is near the Pale, Hjaalmarch, and Haafingar travel boundaries; Dawnstar is proposed as the closest ordinary hub.

frostflow_lighthouse.reason: The lighthouse sits on the long north coast between Dawnstar and Winterhold.

northwind_summit.reason: The summit is near the Eastmarch/Rift transition and can be approached from either Windhelm or Riften.

forsaken_cave.reason: The cave is on the long road between Windhelm and Dawnstar; Windhelm is proposed for the easier eastern approach.

irkngthand.reason: The ruin lies in the eastern Pale but is also naturally approached from Windhelm.

raven_rock.reason: Raven Rock is clearly the island's primary service hub; review concerns whether Solstheim should be split at all.

severin_manor.reason: The home is unambiguously in Raven Rock; its status follows review of the proposed island region model.

raven_rock_mine.reason: The mine begins inside Raven Rock; its status follows review of the proposed island region model.

kolbjorn_barrow.reason: The barrow is a repeated southern expedition staged from Raven Rock; review concerns the proposed island split.

tel_mithryn.reason: Tel Mithryn is a secondary settlement far east of Raven Rock and could justify different grouping, but a third micro-region is not proposed.

nchardak.reason: The eastern ruin is reached with Neloth from Tel Mithryn and sits between the proposed southern and northern operating areas.

temple_of_miraak.reason: The central temple is connected to both Raven Rock quest staging and the Skaal storyline.

earth_stone.reason: The stone is adjacent to Raven Rock; its status follows review of the island split.

water_stone.reason: The southwestern stone is most practical from Raven Rock; its status follows review of the island split.

fort_frostmoth.reason: The southern fort is most practical from Raven Rock; its status follows review of the island split.

ashfallow_citadel.reason: The citadel is north of Raven Rock near the transition between proposed operating areas.

skaal_village.reason: Skaal Village is the proposed northern expedition hub; review concerns whether it warrants a separate operational region.

saerings_watch.reason: The far-northern lair supports the Skaal hub proposal but can still be reached as one long Raven Rock trip.

benkongerike.reason: The northern cave supports the Skaal hub proposal but can still be treated as a Raven Rock expedition.

white_ridge_barrow.reason: The northern barrow supports the Skaal hub proposal but can still be treated as a Raven Rock expedition.

vahloks_tomb.reason: The tomb is tied to Skaal quests but lies far enough south to make the boundary subjective.

wind_stone.reason: The stone is beside Skaal Village; its status follows review of the island split.

beast_stone.reason: The northern stone supports the Skaal grouping; review concerns the overall island split.

sun_stone.reason: The northern stone supports the Skaal grouping; review concerns the overall island split.

tree_stone.reason: The stone is beside the centrally located Temple of Miraak and could reasonably follow either proposed island region.

thirsk_mead_hall.reason: The hall is near Skaal Village, but its viability as a repeat staging point depends on quest choices.

hrothmunds_barrow.reason: The northern quest site follows Thirsk/Skaal travel, but a unified island model remains plausible.
